sismo.title: We work with Sismo
sismo.intro: Sismo structural panels enable rapid, robust builds with excellent thermal and acoustic performance. The system combines engineering precision with on-site efficiency, delivering walls and slabs that are strong, fast to install, and environmentally responsible.

items.subtitle: Speed without shortcuts
items.body: Each Sismo panel is factory-produced to exact dimensions, arriving on-site ready to assemble like a modular shell. This prefabrication drastically reduces construction time while maintaining accuracy and quality. Once panels are positioned, concrete is poured to form a continuous structure, allowing CÉU teams to build complete homes and structures in a fraction of the usual schedule.
items.alt: Sismo panel installation showing rapid progress

items.subtitle: Monolithic strength
items.body: After concrete is poured, the panels become a single monolithic wall system, a reinforced, continuous structure that resists cracking, deformation, and moisture. This solid concrete core ensures long-term stability, low maintenance, and excellent seismic and wind performance. Every Sismo build by CÉU is designed to meet or exceed European structural standards.
items.alt: Reinforced concrete core detail of a Sismo wall

items.subtitle: Comfort & efficiency
items.body: Sismo’s insulated design naturally improves thermal comfort and reduces energy use. The panels integrate insulation materials directly into the structure, minimizing thermal bridges and ensuring a constant indoor temperature. The airtight system also improves acoustic insulation, making interiors quieter and more comfortable, ideal for both residential and commercial buildings in the Algarve’s demanding climate.
items.alt: Interior view highlighting thermal and acoustic comfort benefits

items.q: Do you work only with Sismo?
items.a: We build with Sismo where it adds value, and we also deliver traditional methods. We recommend the best approach for your budget, schedule, and performance goals.
We primarily serve the Algarve. For larger projects we consider work across Portugal.

items.q: How fast is Sismo compared to traditional builds?
items.a: Sismo panels install rapidly and reduce coordination steps. Actual gains depend on design and site logistics, but schedules are typically shorter than traditional masonry.
No. We self-perform with our own team and equipment, which helps us control quality, safety, and timelines.

items.q: Can you help before I have a full project set?
items.a: Yes. We offer early design-build support to validate assumptions, align budgets, and surface constructability issues before they become costly.
Yes. We maintain the appropriate registrations and insurance. We can share documentation during preconstruction.
Send a short brief and any drawings you have. We will schedule a call or site visit and provide next steps with a clear plan.
Yes. We stand behind our workmanship and the systems we install. Specific terms depend on the project scope and materials.
